changes.comment: KG Phase 2 (#1258): populate the knowledge graph as a derived ecosystem mirror. Projects Workspace/Session/Persona/Environment/Task nodes + structural edges (from SQL FKs) and transcript chunks (from session logs) into Neo4j via idempotent MERGE upserts. Adds an incremental event subscriber, a reconciliation projection phase (session sync + per-session transcript cursor + off-write-path embedding backfill), and a startup-if-empty rebuild() that deterministically re-projects from SQL + logs (recovery = re-project, never replay). knowledge-core gains MERGE upsert primitives, structural EDGE_TYPEs, and a (sourceType,sourceId) uniqueness constraint.
